name: Mem0

paper.title: Mem0: Building Production-Ready AI Agents with Scalable Long-Term Memory

construction.processing: LLM extracts salient facts from message pair, summary, last 10 messages

organization.structure: flat (+ directed labeled entity graph in Mem0^g)
organization.stores: vector database (+ Neo4j graph for Mem0^g)

management.operations: ADD / UPDATE / DELETE / NOOP chosen per candidate fact
management.conflicts: LLM compares each new fact with the 10 most similar memories
management.forgetting: DELETE of contradicted memories; Mem0^g marks relations invalid instead

retrieval.candidates: Mem0^g: entity-anchored subgraph plus query-triplet similarity; base Mem0 unstated
retrieval.selection: Mem0^g: triplets above relevance threshold, ranked by similarity

use.context: timestamped memories of both speakers (+ graph relations for Mem0^g)

stages.ingestion: Processes each new message pair together with an asynchronously refreshed conversation summary and the last m=10 messages.
stages.construction: An LLM (GPT-4o-mini) extracts a set of salient candidate facts from the new exchange. Mem0^g additionally extracts entities and relationship triplets.
stages.organization: Flat store of natural-language memories in a vector database; the graph variant stores a directed labeled entity graph in Neo4j.
stages.update: Each candidate fact is compared with the top s=10 similar memories and an LLM tool call chooses ADD, UPDATE, DELETE or NOOP. Mem0^g marks conflicting relations invalid instead of deleting them.
stages.retrieval: Dense similarity search over memories; Mem0^g adds entity-anchored subgraph expansion plus dense matching over relationship triplets.
stages.answer: Retrieved timestamped memories of both speakers are placed in an answer prompt (App. A).

summary: Extracts salient facts from each message pair and lets an LLM consolidate them against similar existing memories with ADD/UPDATE/DELETE/NOOP; an optional graph variant stores entity-relation triplets.
notes:
AXES-CHECK: the paper does not state a top-10 retrieval size at query time; s=10 is the number of similar memories used in the update phase (Sec 2.1). Embedding model for Mem0's own store is not named. Graph variant (Mem0^g) is recorded as system mem0, variant 'graph'. Venue from IOS Press FAIA vol. 413 (ECAI 2025); paper points to https://mem0.ai/research for code.
DESIGN: Sec 2.1-2.2, Sec 3.3, Sec 4.5, App. A. Corrected: 'add/update/delete' moved from construction.processing to management.operations; retrieval 'dense top-10' dropped (s=10 is update-phase, query-time k not stated).
